item.title: A misspelt type (excercise)
item.description: This page says type: excercise. There is no such layout, so Hugo uses the theme’s plain default page: no contents list, no prev/next, no exercise styling. No warning is given.

item.title: A page with no type
item.description:
Same weight (1) as the misspelt one: equal weights are ordered by title. No type, so the default layout is used. display_toc: true works on this kind of page.

item.title: A very long title that goes on and on, because some people put a whole sentence, the learning outcomes and the week number in the title of every page, week 7
